summary: The real third-person shooter is back.
description: A city hidden from the rest of the world. For years, it operated as a massive prison complex, housing the world’s most dangerous criminals. Thieves, killers, warlords - each sentenced to life, locked away forever. But nothing stays caged forever. This place was a powder keg - and now it’s exploded. A prison break. A full-blown breakout. The walls have fallen, and the prisoners have seized control. Waves of enraged inmates - rebels against the old order - now dominate the ruins. Every corner of the city echoes with gunfire, bloodshed, and chaos. All security forces were wiped out in the first strike. Civilians fled into the forests. And your partner - your only backup - has gone missing. Communications? Dead. You’re the last line between survival and total collapse. This is no ordinary mission. This is a warzone. You’ll need to become a one-person army - strike fast, stay sharp, and shoot to survive. Equip yourself like a true Gun Pro. Choose your loadout from a huge variety of weapons and tools, and blast your way through hordes of enemies in intense third-person shooter action. If you're into action games, shooter games, or offline shooting games, you're in for a brutal fight. Explore the lawless city in this gritty 3rd person shooter, where every street hides danger, secrets, or salvation. This isn't just about surviving - it's about finding your missing comrade, uncovering the truth, and maybe, just maybe, putting an end to this rebellion. Whether you're a solo survival junkie or a veteran of shooter games offline, this one’s for you. From brutal story-driven missions to arena-style chaos, it's all here. Game Features: • Third-person shooter gameplay with tight, responsive controls. • A wide variety of enemies - each requiring a different strategy to defeat. • A huge arsenal of weapons: from pistols and rifles to heavy firepower. • Squad mechanics - recruit partners, gear up, and become the ultimate rebel force. • Rich story campaign full of dark humor, dialogue, and memorable characters. • Arena mode - survive wave after wave in a brutal test of endurance. • Vast, open city filled with dangers, secrets, and high-risk missions. • Highly detailed graphics with gritty, immersive visuals. • Optimized for both modern and older devices. • Simple, intuitive controls with complete freedom of movement. • Full gamepad support. Play anywhere - offline shooting game support lets you fight anytime. Inspired by the spirit of games like PlayerUnknown and Stryker, this is one of those rare rebel games that mixes raw intensity with tactical survival. The city has fallen. It's time to take it back.
